# netbox_cooling_intake_template (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/coolingintaketemplate/):

> A cooling intake template describes a liquid cooling inlet that is created on every device that is built from a device type or module type.

Requires NetBox v4.7.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_cooling_intake_template" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number)
- `diameter` (Number)
- `diameter_unit` (String) One of [mm, cm, in].
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `max_flow` (Number)
- `max_flow_unit` (String) One of [lpm, m3ph, gpm].
- `module_type_id` (Number)
- `type` (String) One of [uqd, uqdb, qdc, camlock, npt, bsp, proprietary].

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
